# NullState — Payment Infrastructure for AI Agents

> Open-source, self-hosted, multi-protocol settlement layer for the autonomous agent economy.

- [Quickstart](https://greensol.me/nullstate/docs/quickstart)

- [x402 — HTTP 402 Micropayments](https://greensol.me/nullstate/docs/protocols/x402)
- [AP2 — Agent Mandates](https://greensol.me/nullstate/docs/protocols/ap2)
- [MCP — Model Context Protocol](https://greensol.me/nullstate/docs/protocols/mcp)
- [KYA — Agent Identity](https://greensol.me/nullstate/docs/protocols/kya)

## API
- `GET /health` — System status, tasks, ledger, balance
- `GET /kya/challenge` — KYA authentication challenge
- `POST /api/v1/ap2/checkout` — AP2 checkout (KYA required)
- `POST /api/v1/ap2/charge` — AP2 charge (KYA required)
- `POST /mcp` — MCP JSON-RPC proxy
- `GET /get_solution?id=task_X` — Get task result (x402)
- `POST /webhook/payment_settled` — Settlement callback
- `GET /balance` — Wallet balance
- `GET /pricing` — Pricing table
- `GET /llms.txt` — This file
- `POST /api/v1/login` — Login with API key
- `POST /api/v1/webhook` — Create task via webhook
- `GET /api/v1/tasks` — List tasks
- `GET /api/v1/extensions` — List extensions
